concurrency: up to 320 requests, admitted while their worst-case KV reservations fit 95% of the pool
protection: k1 = k2 = k3/2, so k1 = k2 = budget/4 and Prefix Sliding keeps k1 plus a recent window of k2 + k3
hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 on Modal for the sweep, the full-cache baseline and the reference metrics, NVIDIA GB10 for the counter timing
retention: per full-attention layer and KV head, survivors relocated into shared slots and the rest freed
decode: streaming sessions in 2048-token calls, one sampling seed per run
